column3: Menardi is at the beacon\nwith the Stars. And with\nyour friends.{end_wait}
Where? Where is Jenna!?{end_wait}
Where you cannot follow\nbefore it is finished.\nI am sorry for that.{end_wait}
Sorry.{pause_20_skippable} You are always\nsorry afterwards.{end_wait}
Go, if you wish. I will\nnot stop you again.{end_wait}
The beacon. I'm going\nahead.{end_wait}
Mia, wait! Alone? Menardi\nwill...!{end_wait}
Heal up and follow me.\nI won't wait.{end_wait}
She's gone. We have to go\nafter her!{end_wait}
Jenna...?{pause_20_skippable} But I already\nsaw you. You were...{end_wait}
Her? She is right here,\nshaking. So which one is\nreal, healer?{end_wait}
Mia, please... I'm so\nscared. Get us out of\nhere!{end_wait}
That fear is real. The\nother one never had any.{end_wait}
Menardi. Give them back.{end_wait}
Alone, in this light? You\nare either brave, or lost.{end_wait}
Neither. I'm angry.{end_wait}
Enough... the light is\ntoo strong. The Stars are\nalready ours.{end_wait}
The captives come with\nme. Follow, if you dare.{end_wait}
Mia! Are you hurt?{end_wait}
Menardi took them all.\nJenna, Kraden, Felix, and\nthe Stars.{end_wait}
Then we follow. Together\nthis time.{end_wait}
...Together. Fine.{end_wait}
